articles.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 rolls onto AWS: faster, cheaper LLM for builders
articles.dek: Anthropic’s latest small model lands on Amazon Bedrock with up to 75 % lower token cost and a speed edge that makes it the new default for quick‑turn inference.

body.text: Key Takeaway

Claude Haiku 5.5 is now available on AWS Bedrock, billed as the fastest Anthropic small model and costing about three‑quarters less per input token than the previous Haiku release [FACT:e160fd43330c5340c1c2cc16e2bafba1][FACT:4cdc9834c717064a4ae213ab7debf28d][FACT:0f53be6e4bef9ae6db8f6e45deef7d18].

body.title: Anthropic
body.caption: Based on extracted data from The Decoder, MarkTechPost.

body.text: Why This Matters

The model lives inside the same Bedrock APIs you already use, so your existing IAM policies and billing dashboards absorb the change without a new vendor contract [FACT:021811ef31d4d6b7ecedceea12ea5f58][FACT:bbd95946c0bfe3accc39462b4bfd5f18].  Its cheaper per‑token price puts it on par with GPT‑4‑Turbo’s $0.10 per‑M‑input‑token rate, easing budget pressure for high‑throughput workloads [FACT:27bb9b0d7cb35c6aafab755f098e0567][FACT:21d9e4f407dc4b6f891036709534984a].
What Happened

Amazon announced the general‑availability of Claude Haiku 5.5 on October 7, 2026, and the model is listed alongside Anthropic’s other offerings in the Bedrock catalog [FACT:89899c11d979ec1cedd9f72011218aad].
Builder View

From a builder’s perspective you can spin up a Haiku 5.5 endpoint with the same SDK calls you use for Claude Instant or Claude 2 — no code changes required [FACT:50f51ff5d3cfcef90cf34c51a32ad7b4][FACT:abcbc85a166bae1efe8a995504cd9f44].  The lower token price shrinks your AWS bill line‑item, and the advertised speed boost reduces latency for real‑time features like chat assistants or code completion [FACT:e160fd43330c5340c1c2cc16e2bafba1][FACT:4cdc9834c717064a4ae213ab7debf28d].
Open Questions

What remains untested is how the claimed speed translates under sustained load in a multi‑tenant Bedrock environment, and whether the 1 M‑token context window will stay static as other Anthropic models evolve.  Pricing after the first 100 k tokens still follows a tiered increase, so very large prompts could see higher marginal cost [FACT:0ae00225b32a24809ece776e2e30a2a6].
Ardur Take

Four independent sources corroborate the launch, speed claim, and price cut, giving us high confidence that Claude Haiku 5.5 is production‑ready on AWS and worth trying out in any workload that currently relies on a small LLM [FACT:89899c11d979ec1cedd9f72011218aad][FACT:e160fd43330c5340c1c2cc16e2bafba1][FACT:4cdc9834c717064a4ae213ab7debf28d][FACT:21d9e4f407dc4b6f891036709534984a].

keyPoints: Claude Haiku 5.5 enters AWS Bedrock as the fastest small Anthropic model.
Per‑token cost drops roughly 75 % versus the previous Haiku version.
Same Bedrock APIs and IAM controls mean zero integration friction.
Pricing now matches the $0.10 per‑M‑token level of leading GPT models.
articles.whyItMatters: For teams building chatbots, code‑assist tools, or any high‑volume LLM service, the combination of speed and a dramatically lower token price can shave both latency and cloud spend without re‑architecting your stack.
articles.readerAction: Create a Claude Haiku 5.5 endpoint in the Bedrock console, run a quick token‑cost benchmark against your current model, and evaluate latency for your target use case.
